name: Stavanger

queries.query: Stavanger official cadastral parcel map property map Norway matrikkel kart Stavanger kommune
queries.result: Found Stavanger municipality's official map/property-information page, which links kommunekart.com for property boundaries and farm/use numbers, and links Kartverket's national Eiendomskart/Eiendomsregisteret. Found Kartverket's public Eiendom API documentation.

queries.query: Stavanger kommune eiendomskart matrikkel kart offisiell
queries.result: The official Stavanger page states that kommunekart.com exposes eiendomskart (property boundaries) and gårds- og bruksnummer; Kartverket documents the national Matrikkelen property map and public localization API.

registryBasis: Stavanger municipality is the local map/property-information custodian and directs users to kommunekart.com; Kartverket is the national Matrikkelen custodian. The public Kartverket Eiendom API returned live parcel geometry and native cadastral identity components.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National Matrikkelen property localization service; Stavanger municipality map viewer is a local presentation route.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three nearest property areas were returned in a bounded 100 m query at the preserved WUP point; a 3000 m query with the same three-result cap returned the same nearest three. This does not qualify citywide completeness.

sourceFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: The API returned kommunenummer=1103 and matrikkelnummertekst values 17/145, 17/1972, and 18/4. The retained id is the source cadastral municipality number plus the source-generated matrikkelnummertekst; no internal row number was used.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Stavanger-linked viewer shell loaded. Current JavaScript bundle was inspected; it exposes Norkart map/WMS configuration but no anonymous parcel vector response was extracted from the shell alone.
Current Kartverket Norgeskart JavaScript was inspected. It identifies the public cadastral WMS route and the production API base; no credentials were used.
Returned JSON unauthorized/invalid username or password; no login or credential attempt was made and no geometry was inferred from this route.
Public OpenAPI schema confirms anonymous /punkt and /punkt/omrader operations, input CRS parameters, maximum radius 3000 m, GeoJSON area response, and native cadastral fields.

Returned three Polygon features, including one exact-point hit. Raw source properties were retained only in ignored scratch evidence; the cohort sample contains geometry and one canonical id property per feature.
Returned the same nearest three features under the larger bounded radius because maksTreff=3; this is not a citywide coverage test.

remainingUncertainty: The live public API is qualified for bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry retrieval, but no citywide completeness, adapter behavior, cache strategy, or independent serial runtime review has been established. Parcel accuracy is also source-qualified only as Kartverket's published warning allows; exact point preservation and a 0 m hit do not imply a city boundary.
nextStep: Independent serial reviewer should validate the Kartverket adapter contract and bounded coverage behavior before any runtime admission.
